sentences.en: The President vetoed the bill, but Congress overrode his veto.
sentences.zh: 总统否决了这项法案，但国会推翻了他的否决。

sentences.en: Her ambition was consummated when she was elected to Congress.
sentences.zh: 她当选为国会议员时实现了自己的抱负。

sentences.en: He began to work to get Congress to reduce taxes.
sentences.zh: 他开始努力促使国会降低税率。

senses.zh: （代表）大会；（美国等国的）国会，议会
